bh_square_fingerprint.meaning: 5 rational curves and one genus-4 curve

fibers.place: ten roots above the five roots of Q(s)

family.parameter_open: delta is nonzero; the displayed I2 coefficient is nonzero; Q is squarefree, has no root s=0, and shares no root with A; these are nonempty Zariski-open conditions

hyperbolic_handoff.abstract_polytope_novelty: known; this is a new explicit algebraic realization in the project

generic_exactness.argument: The recovery Jacobian is the 4 by 4 identity, the normalized coordinate stabilizer is finite, and the marked-to-unmarked forgetful map has zero-dimensional fibers by the integral F,O class argument.  Thus the four normalized coefficients give four K3 moduli.  Since sigma is primitive order 4 and sigma^2 is the identity on the displayed lattice, T is a Q(i)-module, so rank(T) and rho are even.  Since rho>=12, a strict jump would have rho>=14 and rank(T)<=8, whose primitive-eigenvalue period ball has dimension at most 3.  This contradicts the four-dimensional family.  Hence very general rho=12.

marked_to_unmarked_zero_dimensional.automorphisms: H^0(X,T_X)=0 for a K3 surface, so Aut(X) is discrete; no positive-dimensional forgetful fiber remains
marked_to_unmarked_zero_dimensional.integral_classes: a marked elliptic fibration and section determine integral classes F,O in NS with F^2=0, O^2=-2, and F.O=1; these classes are locally constant
marked_to_unmarked_zero_dimensional.uniqueness: for fixed F,O, the pencil |F| and section O recover the fibration up to PGL2; the displayed base and short-Weierstrass normalizations leave only the finite stabilizer above

generic_exactness.normalizations: the unique II* fiber fixes infinity; base scaling puts the exchanged I2 pair at +/-1; Weierstrass homothety normalizes the nodal cubic to A(1)=-3,C(1)=2

normalized_coordinate_stabilizer.base: commuting with t->-t and fixing the unique II* fiber leaves t->c*t; preserving {+1,-1} gives c^2=1
normalized_coordinate_stabilizer.weierstrass: preserving A(1)=-3 and C(1)=2 gives lambda^4=lambda^6=1, hence lambda^2=1

generic_exactness.scope: exact for the geometric generic/very general member; no particular rational parameter quadruple is Picard-certified here

mordell_weil_very_general.reason: Shioda--Tate after exact rho=12; the no-overlattice argument rules out a torsion saturation

neron_severi.primitive_at_rank_12: an index-two even overlattice would be even unimodular of signature (1,11), impossible since 1-11 is not divisible by 8

picard_action.description: identity on U+E8(-1); sigma exchanges the fibers t=+1 and t=-1 and hence swaps their two A1 root components

primitive_glue.description: with f=R_++R_- and c=R_+-R_-, the original A1^2 is obtained from <f>+<c> by adjoining (f+c)/2=R_+

theorem: On a nonempty Zariski-open set of (alpha,beta,gamma,delta), the very general minimal resolution of y^2=x^3+A(t^2)x+t*C(t^2) has NS=U+E8(-1)+A1(-1)^2.  The primitive order-four automorphism (x,y,t)->(-x,i*y,-t) exchanges the two I2 root components, realizes BH 0.4.4.1, and therefore explicitly realizes the archived finite-volume noncompact H10/12 Coxeter section.
